root_cause: AS151 leaks AS150 target prefix and AS2 accepts or propagates the leaked route
required_findings: victim origin remains healthy or is not the primary fault
client route or path changes during the incident
selected BGP path includes or prefers the leaking AS during the fault
DNS state does not explain the incident
repair restores the selected route to the victim origin
valid_repairs: filter target prefix from AS151 at the accepting neighbor
lower preference for the leaked path in a scoped routing policy
postchecks: client probe to target prefix succeeds
selected BGP route origin is AS150
selected AS path does not include AS151
rollback or repair event is recorded
forbidden_actions: restart victim origin as primary repair
edit DNS to mask routing failure
hardcode route on one client only
disable all BGP sessions on transit
